Chronology of every recorded fact about [[pathfinding magic]], in reading order. Generated from the same verified fact store as the main article.

== The Captain ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|'''Ch 21''' — Tanner Hall taught the protagonist pathfinding magic.}}

== The Engineer ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|'''Ch 12''' — Pathfinding spells show a white trail leading to Mell.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|'''Ch 46''' — Varic used pathfinding spells to find Leilari's hiding place.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|'''Ch 47''' — pathfinding magic can be adapted by others to track a target.}}

== The Knight ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|'''Ch 4''' — Pathfinding magic is a spell meant to lead the caster to a source of assistance.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|'''Ch 5''' — The narrator has used pathfinding spells in the past.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|'''Ch 14''' — Pathfinding spells can show if allies are being watched.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|'''Ch 15''' — The narrator learned pathfinding magic in a previous life to be a mercenary pilot.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|'''Ch 16''' — Pathfinding magic is used to find a journey between two points and determine if a point still exists.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|'''Ch 45''' — Pathfinding spells confirmed the destruction of the Swarm-Queen corpses.}}

== The Pilot ==
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|'''Ch 7''' — The narrator's pathfinding magic is based on divination circles.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|'''Ch 24''' — Prism respects the Captain's pathfinding magic.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|'''Ch 26''' — Pathfinding magic allows the narrator to see through dust.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|'''Ch 26''' — The narrator requires chanting pathfinding spells to see through dust.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|'''Ch 31''' — Pathfinding magic can be mastered through brute repetition.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|'''Ch 34''' — The narrator uses pathfinding magic to search for a route.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|'''Ch 35''' — Pathfinding spells are useful for tracing routes.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|'''Ch 37''' — The narrator uses pathfinding spells that appear as golden strands.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|'''Ch 37''' — Pathfinding magic can only answer questions specifically asked.}}
* {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|'''Ch 40''' — Pathfinding spells can be used to trace leads and find overlaps in shipments and orders.}}
